result:
Review complete. **Verdict: reject.**

The new `src/lib/browser-execution/` engine is well-designed (deterministic-first tier fallback, fail-open caching, correctly avoids pulling the DB-backed `prompt-compiler` barrel into a client bundle) and its 43 unit tests all pass. But the diff breaks the TypeScript build: the `LLMUsage` type was moved to `llm-pricing.ts`, and `llm-client.ts` was left with a type *re-export* (`export type { LLMUsage } from "./llm-pricing"`) instead of an *import* — that doesn't bind the name locally, so llm-client.ts's own ~10 internal function signatures that reference `LLMUsage` no longer resolve, producing 11 `TS2304` errors on `tsc --noEmit`. This is exactly the gap the worker's own PROGRESS.md flagged as unverified ("Full repo tsc/lint pass has NOT been run... Must run before merge") — and it doesn't in fact pass. No `.github/workflows/**` files are touched. Findings written to `review-verdict.json`.
